verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents DNS hosting on its own authoritative nameservers, with create/read/replace/delete of records through the API and the gddy CLI (e.g. `gddy dns set --type A`), so DNS hosting with the domain is delivered. However, nothing shows which record types are supported or what minimum TTL is allowed, and a hands-on user complaint calls the domain management interface very slow, which cuts against a UI that 'doesn't fight me'. Missing for 10: documented support for every record type, documented low TTL limits, evidence of a responsive and developer-friendly management UI, independent corroboration of DNS hosting quality.

support.subject: As a developer, full DNS hosting comes with the domain — every record type, low TTLs, and a management UI that doesn't fight me

citations.quote: Create, read, replace, and delete DNS records for domains hosted on GoDaddy's authoritative nameservers
move from domain search to purchase to DNS management without leaving your terminal
